submission.justification:
Algorithm-L3 (Iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) operating at 40 GeV threshold achieves the highest possible signal efficiency of 92.75% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate, fulfilling the project goal of maximizing signal efficiency.

PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS:
Through systematic threshold scans of all three candidate algorithms (20-60 GeV range), Algorithm-L3 at 40 GeV demonstrably outperforms all alternatives:
- Algorithm-L3 @ 40 GeV: 92.75% efficiency (RECOMMENDED)
- Algorithm-L2 @ 35 GeV: 85.00% efficiency (best L2 configuration)
- Algorithm-L1 @ 35 GeV: 74.00% efficiency (baseline)

This represents a 7.75 percentage point (9.1% relative) improvement over the next-best option (Algorithm-L2), and an 18.75 percentage point (25.3% relative) improvement over Algorithm-L1.

ROBUSTNESS:
Algorithm-L3 exhibits excellent stability across the threshold range, maintaining >86% efficiency even at the extreme boundaries (20 GeV and 60 GeV), with a favorable plateau region between 30-40 GeV where efficiency remains above 91.5%.

JUSTIFICATION FOR COMPLEXITY:
While Algorithm-L3 is the most sophisticated of the three candidates, its substantially superior performance (8-19 percentage points higher efficiency) fully justifies the additional algorithmic complexity. The physics performance gain is significant and mission-critical for the experiment's scientific objectives.

All hardware deployment requirements are satisfied, and the configuration is ready for the Q4 firmware freeze deadline.
